statements.quote: CoreWeave, as our anchor tenant, has leased a total of 526 MW of critical IT capacity for a period of 15 years, generating an anticipated average annual revenue of over $1B for the combined three phases.
statements.notes: "Over $1B" is a lower bound, recorded as $1B. It is an average annual AI/HPC data-center lease revenue over the 15-year term once all three phases are operational, not guidance for a specific fiscal year. Phases are delivered 1H26 through 2028, so the default of the year after the reported year would overstate near-term revenue. FY25 Data Centers segment revenue of $7.2M (p01, p08) appears only in tables, with no quotable sentence, so it is not recorded.
